name: RouterBench
description: RouterBench is a large-scale, publicly available dataset designed to evaluate the decision-making capabilities of unified LLM routing frameworks across multiple LLM pools and domains. It measures the ability of routers to predict response quality and generation cost, facilitating scalable and cost-effective deployment of diverse language models.
reputation: A recent benchmark for LLM routing research that is gaining attention in model-routing and cost-aware deployment work, but is not yet a long-established standard.
notes: Enables evaluation across multiple LLM pools and domains; focuses on predicting response quality and generation cost; uses a new exponential reward function.
